Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 12

“There was never a time when I did not exist, nor you, nor these kings; nor will any of us cease to be hereafter.”

The argument opens at the widest possible scale, and Krishna includes himself and the assembled kings in it. Continuity is not a privilege of the divine — it is the ordinary condition of everyone on the field.
